subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should WhatsApp sticker delivery use an explicit opt-in field on normal sends, or should OpenClaw introduce a distinct cross-channel sticker action?
rationale: This is a new public messaging capability, and choosing automatic detection versus an explicit flag/action determines compatibility, tool semantics, validation, and whether other channel adapters must share the contract.

options.title: Use explicit send intent
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned explicit sticker option so existing WebP image sends remain unchanged while callers deliberately request native sticker delivery.

options.title: Add a portable action
options.body: Introduce a typed cross-channel sticker action only if maintainers want a shared channel capability with consistent semantics beyond WhatsApp.

options.title: Decline bundled support
options.body: Keep the plugin image-only and direct this capability to a separately maintained WhatsApp extension if bundled-channel scope should remain narrower.

recommendation.title: Use explicit send intent
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned explicit sticker option so existing WebP image sends remain unchanged while callers deliberately request native sticker delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history summary places this person on both the WhatsApp outbound path and the shared media boundary affected by the contract choice.
